title: Logic Flaw and Authorization Bypass Checklist
description: Request-tampering mindset: horizontal/vertical authorization bypass and workflow abuse
detail:
1. Horizontal authorization bypass (IDOR): modify id/uid/orderId to access other users' data (try GET/POST/JSON body/cookie)
2. Vertical authorization bypass: call admin endpoints as a regular user (request /admin/* directly, find endpoint names in JavaScript)
3. Password reset: predictable reset links/not sent to the original email/verification code echoed/Host header injection
4. Payment/points: change amount to negative, quantity to decimals, change order status directly, replay requests
5. Verification codes: universal codes/codes echoed/not invalidated/unlimited brute force
6. SMS/email flooding (rarely useful in assessments)
7. Race conditions: concurrent coupon claiming/redemption (Burp Intruder concurrency)
8. Unauthenticated APIs: call endpoints exposed by Swagger directly (try removing auth headers)
9. Cookie/session: deserialization/forgery (JWT entry), session fixation
10. Illusory front-end authorization: disable JavaScript or call APIs directly with curl to bypass
Assessment mindset = real-world vulnerability thinking: map the business flow first, then find breakpoints.
